urgent_handoff_instructions.title: Push MongoDB Development Branch to GitHub

situation.problem: The branch 'feature/crud-operations' and commit 'c5862e3' mentioned in mongodb-development-handoff.json only exist in your local repository
situation.impact: Your colleague cannot access the MongoDB codebase to continue development
situation.solution: Push your local branch and commits to the GitHub remote repository

required_actions.action: Navigate to your HealthTrack-AI project directory
required_actions.description: Go to your local project folder where you've been working

required_actions.action: Check current git status and branch
required_actions.description: Verify you're on the right branch and see current state
required_actions.expected_output: Should show feature/crud-operations branch and any uncommitted changes

required_actions.command: git add . && git commit -m "feat: finalize MongoDB implementation for handoff"
required_actions.description: Save any pending work before pushing
required_actions.conditional: Only if there are uncommitted changes from step 2

required_actions.description: Confirm commit c5862e3 exists in your local history
required_actions.expected_output: Should show the commit hash c5862e3

required_actions.action: Push the feature branch to GitHub
required_actions.description: Upload your local branch to the remote repository
required_actions.critical: This is the main action needed for handoff

required_actions.description: Confirm the branch now exists on GitHub
required_actions.expected_output: Should show the branch with its commit hash

alternative_if_branch_doesnt_exist.situation: If feature/crud-operations branch doesn't exist in your local repo

actions.description: See what branches you actually have

actions.action: Find the commit with MongoDB work
actions.description: Look for commits related to MongoDB development

actions.action: Create the branch from current state
actions.description: Create the branch if it doesn't exist

verification_steps.method: Check the commit history on the branch in GitHub web interface
Verify src/lib/mongodb/ directory exists in the pushed branch

what_to_communicate_back.success_message: ✅ Branch pushed successfully! Your colleague can now run: git fetch && git checkout origin/feature/crud-operations
include_info: Confirm the exact commit hash of the latest push
Any last-minute changes or notes about the MongoDB implementation
Status of the dual-database architecture (working/needs fixes)
Any environment variables or setup steps that might be missing from .env

permission_denied.solution: Check your SSH keys: ssh -T git@github.com

branch_protection.solution: Push to a different branch name and inform colleague

large_files.solution: Check for accidentally committed node_modules or large files: git ls-files --size

if_completely_stuck.fallback_option: Create a new branch with current work and push that instead
commands: git commit -m 'MongoDB implementation ready for handoff'
if_completely_stuck.note: Then inform colleague of the new branch name

time_sensitive.urgency: Your colleague is waiting to start development
time_sensitive.deadline: Please complete within next 30 minutes if possible
time_sensitive.communication: Send a quick message when done: 'Branch pushed to GitHub, ready for handoff'
